revision_reason: Singleton-only validity conflated tiny texture candidates with failure of a dominant face in a single-person task. Replace outcome-independent geometry selection consistently across real calibration and all methods. Use a separate identity encoder as primary.
legacy_policy: singleton-only OpenFace/identity validity; buffalo used as main available identity metric

source_controls.primary_face_choice: largest geometry area, never identity similarity/AU error/model rank
source_controls.invalid_geometry: retain but not rankable; if no finite positive-area geometry then NA
source_controls.selected_invalid_values: affected metric NA; never switch to smaller face to improve a score

openface.input: original canonical512 RGB image; no padding/enhancement
openface.backend: FaceLandmarkImg official CLNF general static AU
openface.selection: largest un-clipped bbox formed by all68 x/y landmarks; geometry-only
openface.confidence: retain continuous value; no confidence cutoff added
openface.primary_validity: selected confidence and all12 AU finite, AU values in[0,5]

output_flag_evidence.scope: six-image paired flag check; each corresponding raw row all17AU unchanged, plus source inspection of output-only flag

identity_primary.name: FaceNet InceptionResnetV1 VGGFace2, facenet-pytorch
identity_primary.role: independent of generator condition and identity-loss encoders
identity_primary.selection: largest un-clipped detector bbox area; retain all boxes/areas/probabilities/landmarks

identity_auxiliary.name: buffalo_l/w600k_r50
identity_auxiliary.selection: largest un-clipped detector bbox area; retain all candidates

primary_metrics.C: manual target12 != source12, not selected by predictions
primary_metrics.no_edit: C empty -> C metricsNA; output invariance tested separately
primary_metrics.paired_policy: per metric common valid cases; cases then subject-equal aggregation; everyn/subjectcount explicit; all failures retained

extra5_diagnostics.reference: same real target selected-face OpenFace measurements, not invented zero manual labels

calibration_order: original12 unique real images FaceNet (parallel allowed)
then all95 dev19 items for three methods and real references
